hypothesis.description: Estimate a time-safe joint Gaussian state over public temperature/salinity, fixed annual harmonics, and the three hidden temperatures, then use its closed-form conditional mean for profile restoration. OAS shrinkage removes scalar regularization search and targets the global vertical covariance failure of local analog manifolds.

model.training_mask: all eight public scalars finite and temp+psal jointly finite for each target layer 2,3,4 at the timestamp
model.training_time: timestamp is at or before the exact sealed eligible prefix terminal timestamp and before the outer fold
model.standardization: training mean and population standard deviation independently per joint variable; zero standard deviation is replaced by one
model.covariance: sklearn.covariance.OAS fitted once to the standardized joint [X,Y] matrix
model.missing_public_fallback: sealed Stage-A prediction_mean for the affected target row
model.postprocess: pinned public-endpoint isotonic profile projection then CSV float roundtrip
model.learned_parameters_per_cell: joint mean, scale, and OAS covariance only

lineage_disclosure.distinct_from_failed_rank2_analog: global shrinkage conditional distribution; no neighbor search, random projection, or local manifold
lineage_disclosure.distinct_from_terminal_offset: time-varying public multivariate state with learned cross-variable covariance; no terminal constant offsets
lineage_disclosure.distinct_from_prior_ridge_screen: joint probabilistic covariance across public temperature, public salinity, season, and all three outputs with analytic OAS shrinkage
